newsitem.title: UK: UK's Brown says will not ignore warning signs. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: UK's Brown says will not ignore warning signs. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]

text.p: UK Chancellor Gordon Brown said on Wednesday that he would not ignore warnings signs of "stop-go" economic activity.
Brown said that there were already signs that the past pattern of accelerating consumer spending and borrowing with skill shortages, capacity constraints, increased imports and rising inflation.
He said there was a risk that output could already be above trend.
"I will not (corrects by inserting dropped word) ignore these warning signs and I will not repeat past mistakes,' he said.
